##### Project general facts

Fay Valley is a sustainable residential community developed by Taraf in partnership with Masdar City, shaped around the connection between wellness, movement, and nature. Featuring a collection of thoughtfully designed villas and townhouses, the community is inspired by landscape, movement, and connection. With a significant portion dedicated to purposeful open space, greenery flows through shaded trails, parks, and walkable corridors that bring calm and balance to everyday life.

Residents enjoy a rich array of amenities designed to support an active and restorative lifestyle. Jogging trails, yoga lawns, padel courts, canopy walks, and outdoor gathering spaces turn active living into part of the everyday rhythm. The Clubhouse serves as the social and wellness heart of the community, featuring pools, yoga spaces, fitness areas, terraces, outdoor lounges, and shaded seating, all surrounded by water, greenery, and landscaped gathering spaces.

Every residence at Fay Valley is designed with floor-to-ceiling openings that frame nature and invite light indoors. The interiors reflect a seamless connection to the outdoors, with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Townhouses and villas range from two to six bedrooms, each crafted as a private sanctuary of life, where architecture frames the landscape and nature frames the experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within Masdar City, this exceptional location represents a new era of urban living where innovation is measured by quality of life. Designed around walkability, sustainability, and comfort, the city brings together shaded streets, integrated greenery, and intelligent design to create a more balanced way of living. Masdar City is not a vision of the future — it is a community already living it.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning at the crossroads of access and escape. Abu Dhabi International Airport, Khalifa City, Yas Island, Zayed University, and the heart of Abu Dhabi are all within easy reach. The community is shaped around a natural wadi, with greenery, water features, and shaded pathways creating a calm and restorative environment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies sustainable living, natural harmony, and a forward-thinking community, Masdar City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of innovation, walkability, and connection to nature makes it one of Abu Dhabi's most desirable addresses. This is a place where everyday feels like a weekend — restorative, connected and effortlessly balanced.
